$comment: The letterheads this server can render onto. THIS IS THE FALLBACK COPY.
A real deployment does not edit this file. It puts its own letterheads.json,
next to its own .docx files, in the directory named by LETTERHEAD_DIR — so an
organization's office names and branding stay out of this public repository.
This copy is what the server uses when LETTERHEAD_DIR has no registry, which
is what lets a fresh install start and generate a letter immediately.
Each entry needs a .docx containing docxtemplater placeholders. Copy
templates/letterheads/generic.docx and restyle it with your artwork; keep the
{placeholders}.
id                  stable machine name; what letterhead_id accepts
label               human name, shown by the list_letterheads tool
file                filename within the registry's directory
aliases             free-text spellings a model might be handed for this office
legalserver_offices exact office names as they appear in LegalServer, if you
use it, so a matter lookup resolves to the right letterhead
include_unit_name   optional; when true, a unit_name argument is added to the
signature block for this office only
defaultId  which letterhead to use when nothing matches
stopWords  words ignored when matching office names. Add your organization's
own name so 'Example Legal Aid — Riverside Office' matches
'riverside'.
Full walkthrough: README.md
